business_overview.one_sentence: The Group operates Ajisen-branded and related Japanese-style fast casual restaurants in Mainland China and Hong Kong, with supporting noodle and product manufacturing and property rental income.

segments.business_substance: Gross rental income from investment properties

business_overview.revenue_model: Primarily restaurant sales settled by cash, cards and payment platforms; restaurant trade receivables normally settle within 30 days when payment platforms are used.
business_notes: Store count fell from 597 to 562 in 2023, while revenue recovered after pandemic-related operating suspensions ended.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported 2023 profit converted into strong operating cash flow, but IFRS lease principal is in financing cash flow and must be deducted for distributable cash. The three-year lease-adjusted owner cash profit median is RMB55.741 million because 2021-2022 were pandemic-affected and store count continued to decline.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by parent company versus operating subsidiaries beyond the separate company statement; parent company cash was only RMB0.706 million.
Annual report does not identify which restricted bank deposits are included in RMB-denominated balances; main analysis assumes restricted deposits are RMB-denominated.
Annual report does not provide a precise maintenance versus growth capex split; main analysis treats 2023 property, plant and equipment purchase as maintenance/conservative capex.
Investment property disposal taxes and transaction friction cannot be precisely quantified from the annual report; investment properties are excluded from the main detachable net cash metric.
